summary_zh: 本页为绘本第一页，标题为“爱心魔法师”，背景为浅绿色，配有简单图案和数字“1”，标志着故事的开始。

page_text_ocr_zh:
森林东边的小河发大水，河两边
的动物朋友们家里的东西都被水冲
走了，他们变得一无所有。
森林西边的动物朋友们，给森林
东边的朋友们送去衣服和食物，帮他们渡过难关。
森林西边有一只刺猬，他最着急，
因为他在森林东边也有朋友，可是他
拿不出衣服去帮助他们。大家都知道，刺猬浑身长着尖尖的刺，他是没法
穿衣服的。
刺猬为朋友送
去了食物，可是他
觉得这远远不够，
他的朋友还缺少
衣服，他得想办法
帮忙。
page_text_en:
The small river on the east side of the forest flooded, and the belongings of animal friends on both sides of the river were washed away. They became completely destitute.
Animal friends from the west side of the forest sent clothes and food to their friends on the east side to help them get through the crisis.
On the west side of the forest, there was a hedgehog who was most anxious, because he also had friends on the east side, but he couldn't take out clothes to help them. Everyone knew that the hedgehog was covered in sharp spines and couldn't wear clothes.
The hedgehog sent food to his friends, but he felt it was far from enough. His friends still lacked clothes, so he had to think of a way to help.
summary_zh: 森林东边发大水，动物们失去所有物品，西边的朋友们送去衣物和食物帮助他们。刺猬因身上有刺无法穿衣服，虽送了食物，但仍想为朋友解决衣物问题。

ci wei ji de tuantuanzhuan
The hedgehog was frantic, running in circles.
tū rán, cì wēi xiǎng qǐ le zhù de bú yuǎn de hé
Suddenly, the hedgehog thought of the old hippo, Mr. Hippo, who lived not far away.
马爷爷。河马爷爷年纪大了,不出门,
Mr. Hippo. Mr. Hippo was old and never went out,
bù zhī dào wài miàn de qíngkuàng
so he didn't know what was happening outside.
cì wēi qiāo xiǎng le hé mǎ yé
The hedgehog knocked on Mr. Hippo's door.
爷家的门,他把森林东边
He told Mr. Hippo about the flood disaster in the east of the forest.
遭受水灾的事,告诉了河

Mr. Hippo. Mr. Hippo didn't say a word,

said, took out his big coat,
gěi le cì wēi, ràng tā gěi zāo zāi de
and gave it to the hedgehog, telling him to send it to his disaster-stricken friends.
péng yǒu sòng qù
Send it to his friends.
tīng shuō cì wēi cóng hé mǎ yé ye jiā ná le yī jiàn
Hearing that the hedgehog had taken a big coat from Mr. Hippo's house,
dà guò zi, cì wēi de péng yǒu xiǎo tù zi hé sōng shǔ dōu
the hedgehog's friends, the little rabbit and the squirrel, both laughed.

They said: “There's no hippo in the east of the forest. Who would wear such a huge coat? Using this coat to make a tent would be just about right.”

Using this coat to make a tent would be just about right.”
summary_zh: 刺猬为帮助受灾朋友，向河马爷爷求助，河马爷爷慷慨地拿出自己的大褂子。刺猬的朋友小兔子和松鼠看到这件大褂子后，觉得它太大，更适合做帐篷。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“不，它能派上用场！”
刺猬把大褂子拿回了家。这天晚上，刺猬家的灯一直亮着。
小兔子和松鼠不知道刺猬在家干什么。
第二天一早，刺猬就拿着一个包袱出发了。
小兔子和松鼠好奇地跟在后面。
只见刺猬来到森林的东边，走进他的朋友小熊的家里。
page_text_en:
"No, it can be useful!"
The hedgehog took the big coat home. That evening, the light in the hedgehog's house stayed on.
The little rabbit and the squirrel didn't know what the hedgehog was doing at home.
The next morning, the hedgehog set off with a bundle.
The little rabbit and the squirrel curiously followed behind.
They saw the hedgehog arrive at the east side of the forest and walk into his friend bear's house.
summary_zh: 刺猬将河马爷爷的大褂子带回家连夜缝制，第二天一早带着包裹出发，小兔子和松鼠好奇地跟在后面，刺猬来到森林东边的朋友小熊家。

page_text_ocr_zh:
刺猬像变魔术一样，从包里拿出了一件衣服给熊爸爸，这是他用河马爷爷那件大褂子的前片改成的；他又拿出了一件衣服给熊妈妈，这是他用大褂子的后片改成的。

他还用大褂子的两个袖管，给小熊做了件衣服；用剩下的布片，为熊妹妹缝了一条美丽的裙子。
page_text_en:
The hedgehog, like a magician, took out a piece of clothing for Bear Dad from his bag. It was made from the front part of Grandpa Hippo's big coat. He also took out another piece of clothing for Bear Mom, which was made from the back part of the coat.

He used the two sleeves of the big coat to make a piece of clothing for Little Bear; and used the leftover fabric to sew a beautiful skirt for Bear Sister.
summary_zh: 刺猬用河马爷爷的大褂子为小熊一家制作了衣服和裙子，展现了他善良和富有创造力的一面。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，小兔子和松鼠跳出来说：
“小刺猬，你把河马爷爷的大褂子变成了小熊一家的衣服，你好了不起，你是个魔法师。”
小熊一家笑着说：“谢谢我们的魔法师，你把一件大褂子，变成了我们全家的温暖，真了不起！”
page_text_en:
At this moment, the little rabbit and the squirrel jumped out and said:
"Little hedgehog, you turned Grandpa Hippo's big coat into clothes for the little bear's family. You're amazing! You're a magician!"
The bear family laughed and said: "Thank you, our magician! You turned one big coat into warmth for our whole family. You're truly amazing!"
summary_zh: 小兔子和松鼠称赞刺猬把河马爷爷的大褂子变成了小熊一家的衣服，称他为魔法师；小熊一家也感谢刺猬，称赞他将大褂子变成了全家的温暖。
